dedupe_keys.name: a construction waste landfill dataset of two districts in beijing china from high resolution satellite images

description: A construction waste landfill dataset of two districts in Beijing, China from high resolution satellite images is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Shaofu Lin et al. Construction waste is unavoidable in the process of urban development, causing serious environmental pollution. Accurate assessment of municipal construction waste generation requires building construction waste identification models using deep learning technology. However, this process requires high-quality public datasets for model training and validation. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2024. Formats: GeoTIFF, Image, Python. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
